From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>

Cc: Ellen Price <ellen@peopleops.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed announcement: Service Platform realignment & leader handoffs — cascade script (draft)

Team —

Sending a first draft of the leadership announcement and a short cascade script for manager-level messaging. High level: we are proposing to realign the current Platform org into two focused groups — Serving (model serving, runtime, model-ops) and Orchestration (deployments, infra automation, cluster orchestration). The aim is to reduce context switching and give each org a tighter ownership surface ahead of the next product cycle.

Key leader handoffs (proposal):
- Marissa Cole will transition to Head of Serving (reports: serving eng leads, model-runtime teams).
- Vivek remains Head of Infrastructure & Orchestration and will take on cross-cloud capacity planning.
- Product manager transitions and PM handoffs are included in the attached one-pager.

Attachments: cascade_script_v1.docx (manager script) and org-onepager.pdf (proposed org chart + handoffs).

Ask: please:
1) Review the attached script for tone and risk language (esp. wording around "split" vs "realignment").
2) Mark any factual edits in the doc and add any bullets you think should be highlighted during QBR.
3) Confirm stakeholders who must be briefed before sending (legal, sales leadership, key customers).
4) Agree on proposed send window: Friday 21 May after the QBR dry-run, or hold until Monday 24 May if we need additional approvals.

Context: we want a concise public-facing note for the company and a separate manager-level script that includes one-on-one talking points, FAQ, and escalation path. My draft tries to surface the minimal necessary details and emphasize continuity of roadmap and support for impacted teams.

Please add inline comments in the Drive doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1X-cascade-script-v1

Thanks —
Ava
Ava Chen
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Ava — thanks for the draft. A few quick notes:
- Recommend we avoid the word "split" in external language; "realignment" or "focus areas" reads less alarming.
- Add a brief customer impact line: "No service changes expected; support and SLAs unchanged." That will help reassure Sales/CS.
- I think we should include an org chart PNG inline in the manager script so managers can point to it during all-hands.
- Please add a one-line escalation path (who to contact for customer impact) — I suggest: Vivek -> Marissa -> Oncall.

I made a couple of inline comments in the Drive doc. Also I can draft the short blurb for the all-hands if useful.

-Jonas
